name: 324. Vercel AI Gateway image channel on an openai-based custom provider (vercel image channel) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6438 regression, contract C3, C4, C5, C12. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. pp_vercel is configured the way Tokun's reconciler writes the Vercel AI Gateway provider: base_provider_type openai, allowed_requests image_generation and embedding, max_retries 0, a named key. The fixture answers /pp/vercel/v1/images/generations in the OpenAI images shape with no usage block, which is what leaves the gateway only data[] to read: usage.output_images must equal the length of data. Vercel's own image response has not been recorded and its usage fields and single-upstream field were not found; replace the fixture answer with a recorded response, and x_fixture_upstream_pin with Vercel's field, once they are. The rows read back the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: pp_vercel/meta/muse-image-1.0 /v1/images/generations n=2: usage.output_images equals the length of data, from one upstream call (vercel image channel)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('vercel image channel setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
function imageCalls(calls) { return calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/vercel/v1/images/generations'; }); }
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('data carries the two images the upstream delivered', function () { pm.expect(body.data, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('array').with.length(2); });

pm.test('usage.output_images is readable and equals the length of data', function () { pm.expect(body.usage, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.usage.output_images, pm.response.text()).to.equal(body.data.length); });

pm.test('the upstream reported no usage, so no token count is invented', function () { var usage = body.usage || {}; pm.expect(usage.output_tokens, pm.response.text()).to.equal(undefined); pm.expect(usage.input_tokens, pm.response.text()).to.equal(undefined); });

pm.test('the named key served the request', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-key'), JSON.stringify(pm.response.headers.toObject())).to.equal('tk-key-vercel-fixture'); });

wire(function (calls) { var images = imageCalls(calls); pm.test('exactly one upstream call, with the model and n unchanged', function () { pm.expect(images, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); var sent = JSON.parse(images[0].body); pm.expect(sent.model, images[0].body).to.equal('meta/muse-image-1.0'); pm.expect(sent.n, images[0].body).to.equal(2); }); });

item.name: pp_vercel/microsoft/mai-image-2.6 /v1/images/generations with x-bf-passthrough-extra-params: true delivers a nested extra field to the upstream unchanged (vercel image channel)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('vercel image channel setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
function imageCalls(calls) { return calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/vercel/v1/images/generations'; }); }
// Vercel's field that pins a request to one upstream was not found (TXE-6438 open question). This case pins the channel
// it will travel on: a nested top-level object outside the unified structure reaches the upstream body unchanged. When the
// field is known, rename x_fixture_upstream_pin to it.
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('usage.output_images equals the length of data', function () { pm.expect(body.data, pm.response.text()).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(body.usage && body.usage.output_images, pm.response.text()).to.equal(1); });

wire(function (calls) { var images = imageCalls(calls); pm.test('one upstream call carries the extra field unchanged', function () { pm.expect(images, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); var sent = JSON.parse(images[0].body); pm.expect(sent.x_fixture_upstream_pin, images[0].body).to.deep.equal({"gateway": {"fixture_pin": ["fixture-upstream"]}}); pm.expect(sent.model, images[0].body).to.equal('microsoft/mai-image-2.6'); }); });
